summary.text: Taylor Wright, a Libertarian Party elementary school physical education teacher and longtime football coach, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Utah's 4th Congressional District to Mike Kennedy.
He has also worked with adults with special needs.

paragraphs.text: Wright works as a physical education teacher at Ridge View Elementary School in Herriman, Utah, and has coached football at the middle school, high school and college levels; the Salt Lake Tribune's October 2026 candidate guide describes him as a high school teacher.
He has also worked with adults with special needs and hosted a podcast called "Saving Humanity," which the Salt Lake Tribune describes as a self-help podcast.
He received 3.2% of the vote to Mike Kennedy's 53.6%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
